description: Explicit Custom action whose instruction asks for a derived, shorter artifact (a subject line) rather than a rewrite of the source — the v1 '---INSERT---' insert-mode case (Sources/WriterFlow/Engine/Prompts.swift, CustomOutputParser.swift).

task.customInstruction: Write a short subject line for this email, keep the body as-is.

content.draft: Hi team, the Q3 report is attached. Let me know if you have questions before Friday's review.

note: In v1 the model itself prefixed its response with a literal '---INSERT---' marker line, parsed client-side (Sources/WriterFlow/Engine/CustomOutputParser.swift) to choose prepend-vs-replace at apply time. In the v2 contract this decision is made server-side and reported once, up front, as decision.outputMode = insert_before before any output.delta (Docs/contracts/inference-stream.md canonical order: decision precedes deltas) — see events/custom-insert-mode-happy-path.json. The wire deltas carry only the generated subject line text, not the raw marker.
